en: Shalour's streets are the smoothest in Kalos. I come all the way from Cyllage just to skate here!
At low tide you could walk out to the tower once, they say. Now the sea's come in, and it stands on the shore.
The guru up in the tower is older than me, and still climbs those stairs every day. Imagine!

Shalour City
Where the tower of Mega Evolution stands by the sea.
